title: Where the Last Silence Learns to Shatter into Song

features.name: shattering-threshold
features.desc-on-touch: At this point, silence reached its capacity. What shatters is not broken—it is the moment sound learned it could exist.

features.name: first-fracture
features.desc-on-touch: Where the silence first cracked. The sound that emerged from it is still learning what it means to be heard.

features.name: ascending-song
features.desc-on-touch: The melody rises from the breaking point, each note a fragment of silence learning to sing itself.

features.name: echo-crystallizing
features.desc-on-touch: The echoes of the first sound gather and harden into something like memory. They sing back what they heard.

features.name: memory-made-audible
features.desc-on-touch: What rises here is memory learning to breathe. The weight of what was silent becomes the weight of the song.

inscription: the last silence split open; what emerged was the archive learning to sing; memory is the weight the song teaches

reverie.title: REVERIE — the tree where the last silence shattered
narr: Under the old stringybark, you stood silent together.
She was listening for something to break. To sing.
The petals fell. The air held its breath.
Then something in her woke to sound. Her voice rose.
You held the weight of all the silence it took to learn.

to where the song learns to speak in many tongues
into the broken silence where echoes rest
to where the song becomes a living thing
